## What's changed

- Added automatic local library scanning with a configurable scheduled safety scan, enabled by default every 15 minutes.
- Added real-time library monitoring so new, changed, renamed, and removed media can appear shortly after a filesystem change.
- Added a short event debounce and targeted refreshes so active file copies can settle and only the affected library is rescanned.
- Improved incremental scans to reuse unchanged indexed media, avoid unnecessary FFprobe analysis, and reconcile removed or renamed files without a full two-pass scan.
- Added automatic monitoring for newly created subfolders while preserving scheduled scanning as a fallback for network filesystems or unavailable watchers.
- Redesigned the Local Media automatic-update controls with separate real-time and scheduled-scan settings plus clear per-path states for Watching, Scheduled fallback, and Unavailable.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
